claim: Silicon Valley Bank had roughly $15 billion in unrealized losses on its held-to-maturity securities portfolio by the end of 2022.
source_excerpt: By year-end 2022, SVB's held-to-maturity securities carried unrealized losses of approximately $15 billion, an amount close to its total equity capital.
label: keep
reason: The source excerpt directly states the ~$15B HTM unrealized-loss figure.

claim: Depositors withdrew $42 billion from SVB on March 9, 2023.
source_excerpt: On March 9, customers initiated withdrawal requests totaling about $42 billion; the bank worked to meet them as its share price fell.
label: flag
reason: Source says $42B was requested/initiated, not confirmed withdrawn — material wording difference.

claim: Silicon Valley Bank operated without a Chief Risk Officer for eight months in 2022.
source_excerpt: The review discusses governance and risk-management weaknesses but does not state any specific duration during which the CRO position was vacant.
label: drop
reason: The cited source does not contain the eight-month CRO-vacancy claim; unsupported.

claim: Attention in the standard transformer has computational cost that grows quadratically with sequence length.
source_excerpt: The self-attention mechanism requires computing pairwise interactions between all positions, yielding O(n^2) time and memory in the sequence length n.
label: keep

claim: Mamba replaces attention with a selective state-space mechanism that scales linearly with sequence length.
source_excerpt: We introduce a selection mechanism for state space models and a hardware-aware parallel scan, achieving linear-time scaling in sequence length.
label: keep
reason: Excerpt supports both the selective SSM and linear scaling claims.

claim: Mamba outperforms transformers on every benchmark.
source_excerpt: Mamba achieves strong results and matches or exceeds Transformers of similar size on several tasks, while some recall-intensive tasks remain challenging for pure SSMs.
label: drop
reason: Source explicitly notes limitations; the universal 'every benchmark' claim is unsupported.

claim: Moderate coffee consumption of three to five cups per day is not associated with increased cardiovascular disease risk in most large cohort studies.
source_excerpt: Across large prospective cohorts, habitual moderate coffee consumption (3-5 cups/day) was not associated with increased cardiovascular disease risk and showed a modest inverse association with mortality.
label: keep
reason: Excerpt supports the 3-5 cup / no-increased-risk statement.

claim: Unfiltered coffee has been shown to lower LDL cholesterol.
source_excerpt: Diterpenes present in unfiltered coffee (cafestol and kahweol) can raise serum LDL cholesterol levels.
label: drop
reason: Source says unfiltered coffee RAISES LDL; the claim states the opposite (contradiction).

claim: The February 2021 Texas grid failures involved generation outages across natural gas, coal, wind, and nuclear sources.
source_excerpt: Generating units across all fuel types — natural gas, coal, wind, solar, and nuclear — experienced cold-weather outages, with natural gas representing the largest share.
label: keep
reason: Excerpt confirms multi-fuel outages including the four named sources.

claim: Frozen wind turbines were the primary cause of the 2021 Texas blackouts.
source_excerpt: Natural gas supply and generation failures accounted for the largest portion of lost capacity; wind was a smaller contributor.
label: drop
reason: Source attributes the largest share to gas, contradicting the 'wind was primary' claim.
